# A query in a component built at run time, the component removed before its
# answer lands: a detail page under an `if`, left while it is still asking.
#
# The removal tears the instance down, and the teardown bumps the query's
# attempt, so the answer is stale -- but a stale answer still settles, and a
# settle of a torn-down instance found the bracket it had just let go of
# wanted and mounted it again. That mount asked a second time and rendered
# into the instance's freed box, and its answer was not stale: gtk4 reported
# GTK_IS_BOX failures and then crashed in sngl_slot_anchor, and every target
# fired `@load` from an instance no longer on screen.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import http "sngl:http"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func lookup(k string, life async.Lifetime) async.Result[string] {
    match var r = http.get(url="http://127.0.0.1:47819/status/200", life=life) {
        failed { return {failed=r} }
        ok { return {ok=k} }
    }
}

component pane(seen func()) ui.node {
    var busy = false
    var answer option[string] = null
    var more option[string] = null
    async.query(on="a", fetch=lookup, :value=answer, :pending=busy, @load(got) { seen() })
    if answer != null {
        async.query(on=answer + "b", fetch=lookup, :value=more, @load(got) { seen() })
    }
    if busy {
        ui.text(value="asking")
    }
    ui.text(value=more != null ? more : "-")
}

component page ui.node {
    var open = false
    var loads = 0
    if open {
        pane(seen=func() { loads += 1 })
    }
    ui.button #show(text="show", @click { open = true })
    ui.button #hide(text="hide", @click { open = false })
}

func testAPaneRemovedWhileAskingAnswersNothing(t test.Test, c page) {
    c.show.click()
    c.hide.click()
    // The interpreter and android answer at mount, before the hide.
    var gone = c.loads
    t.wait(func() => c.loads > gone, 1000)
    t.assert(c.loads == gone)
}

ui.window {
    page()
}
